content_zh:
“唉？那个帅哥是谁？新来的吗？怎么一次都没有看到过？”女生拉着旁边的人，让她们看博九。
“他刚刚还冲着我笑了！那小虎牙，真性感！”
“等一下，我怎么觉得他这么眼熟，他！他是博九？！“
离近了看，几个女生彻底傻眼了！
这样的美男怎么会是那个暴发户博九？
可他确实进的是她们班！
博九把书包放在木桌上，长腿微搭的坐下，刚要把小型本拿出来。
就听砰的一声！
有人拉开了她旁边的椅子，脸色阴沉的看着她：“把你的东西拿走，老子一秒也不想和你多待，死变态！”
这人是博九的同桌，蒋飞扬，他们D班最帅的男生，打的一手好篮球，颇有女生缘。
就连博九本人曾经都追求过他。
追求过，一想到这三个字，博九顿时就觉得有些头疼。
不过，她这个人向来不喜欢有人在她面前动粗。
＂不想待？＂博九的嗓音很淡，漫不经心的撑着侧脸看着他：＂那就滚。＂
“你说什么！“蒋飞扬一下子就出手了，他想把博九的领子拽过来！
没有想到，他才刚一起身就扑了个空，整个人都栽在了桌面上，下巴磕的生疼。
而站在一旁的博九，嘴角含笑的看着他：＂我最近不喜欢和人动手，所以蒋同学，我们还是好好相处比较好，你觉得呢？＂
所有人都以为他们像是好哥们一样在说悄悄话。
只有蒋飞扬知道压在自己背上的那个手臂力道有多疼，他眼睛发红的咬着牙，简直不相信自己竟然输给了那个小弱渣？！
“真是奇怪，以前蒋飞扬和博九说一句话，博九都会脸红好半天，今天怎么不一样了？”

＂没什么奇怪的吧，现在的博九把眼光都放在了秦少的身上，其他人不想看了呗。”
“呵，真是脸大，连秦少他都敢染指。”
“等着吧，总会有人收拾他。”
一片嘈杂中，博九低眸，翻开了桌上的物理书。
蒋飞扬则是甩了甩收，冷哼了一声：“听到了吧，你活不了多久的，别说秦少本人，就是秦少那些学校护卫队，都能把你弄死。”
闻言，博九又是一笑，从物理书上抬起眸来：“我会不会死是以后的事，但是你再多说一句，我就卸掉你的下巴！”
蒋飞扬：……
妈的，为什么他会有一种被震住的感觉。
刚才这个小废渣的眼神真的好可怕！
上课铃响了，博九总算是可以安静的眯一会。
不过，到了午饭的时候，该来的麻烦还是来了。
一群穿着短裙的女学生，将博九围在了中央，言语之间都带着不好惹的刁钻。
“博家怎么就出了这么一个基佬暴发户，真是恶心！”

content_en:
"Huh? Who is that handsome guy? Is he new here? Why haven't you seen him before?" The girl pulled the people next to her and asked them to look at Bo Jiu.
"He just smiled at me! Those little tiger teeth are so sexy!"
"Wait a minute, why do I think he looks so familiar? Him! Is he Bo Jiu?!"
Looking closer, the girls were completely dumbfounded!
How could such a handsome man be the upstart Bo Jiu?
But he did enter their class!
Bojiu put his schoolbag on the wooden table, sat down with his long legs slightly splayed, and was about to take out the small notebook.
Just hear a bang!
Someone pulled out the chair next to her and looked at her with a gloomy face: "Take your things away, I don't want to spend more time with you for a second, you're such a pervert!"
This person is Bo Jiu's classmate, Jiang Feiyang, the most handsome boy in their Class D. He is a good basketball player and is quite popular with girls.
Even Bojiu himself once pursued him.
After pursuing it, Bo Jiu suddenly felt a headache when he thought of these three words.
However, she never likes people to be violent in front of her.
"Don't want to stay?" Bo Jiu's voice was very light, and she looked at him casually with her side face raised: "Then get out."
"What did you say!" Jiang Feiyang took action immediately. He wanted to pull Bo Jiu's collar over!
Unexpectedly, he fell into the air as soon as he stood up, and his whole body fell on the table, his chin hurting from the knock.
Bo Jiu, who was standing aside, looked at him with a smile on his face: "I don't like to fight with others recently, so classmate Jiang, it's better for us to get along well, what do you think?"
Everyone thought they were whispering like good buddies.
Only Jiang Feiyang knew how painful the arm pressing on his back was. His eyes were red and he was gritting his teeth. He couldn't believe that he had lost to that little weakling? !
"It's really strange. When Jiang Feiyang and Bo Jiu said a word before, Bo Jiu would blush for a long time. Why is it different today?"
"It's not surprising. Now Bo Jiu has set his sights on Young Master Qin, and others don't want to see him."
"Haha, you are so shameless, even Mr. Qin dares to get involved."
"Just wait, someone will take care of him."
Amid the noise, Bo Jiu lowered his eyes and opened the physics book on the table.
Jiang Feiyang shook his head and snorted coldly: "You heard it, you won't live long, not to mention Young Master Qin himself, even Young Master Qin's school guards can kill you."
Hearing this, Bo Jiu smiled again and raised his eyes from the physics book: "Whether I die or not is a matter for the future, but if you say one more thing, I will remove your chin!"
Jiang Feiyang:......
Damn it, why did he feel so shocked.
The look in the eyes of this little loser just now was really scary!
The class bell rang, and Bo Jiu could finally take a quiet squint.
However, at lunch time, the trouble came.
A group of female students in short skirts surrounded Bo Jiu in the center, and their words were full of treacherousness.
"How could the Bo family have such a gay upstart? It's really disgusting!"
